name: Jumping Jacks
cues: Feet together, arms at sides to start
Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead
Jump back to start — that's one rep
Keep a steady, springy rhythm

name: Running in Place (High Knees)
cues: Drive knees up toward hip height
Pump arms like a real sprint
Stay on the balls of your feet
Land light, not flat-footed

name: Push-Up
cues: Hands just outside shoulder width
Body in one straight line, core tight
Lower until chest is near the floor
Press back up without flaring elbows

name: Bodyweight Squat
cues: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out
Sit hips back and down, knees track toes
Thighs to at least parallel
Drive through heels to stand

name: Forward Lunge
cues: Step forward, lower the back knee toward the floor
Front knee stays above the ankle
Push off the front foot to return
Alternate legs each rep

name: Plank Hold
cues: Forearms down, elbows under shoulders
Body one straight line, no sagging hips
Squeeze glutes and brace your core
Breathe — don't hold your breath

name: Mountain Climbers
cues: Start in a high plank
Drive knees toward chest, alternating fast
Keep hips low and steady
Hands stay planted under shoulders

name: Burpee
cues: Squat down, hands to the floor
Kick feet back into a plank
Chest to floor, then push back up
Jump feet in and leap up

name: Glute Bridge
cues: Lie back, knees bent, feet flat
Drive hips up, squeezing glutes at the top
Pause a beat, then lower with control
Keep ribs down, no arching the low back

name: Superman Hold
cues: Lie face down, arms extended forward
Lift chest, arms and legs off the floor together
Hold, squeezing glutes and back
Lower slowly — don't just drop

name: Wall Sit
cues: Back flat against a wall
Slide down until thighs are parallel to floor
Knees stacked over ankles
Hold steady — small wobbles are fine

name: Bicycle Crunch
cues: Hand behind head, opposite hand out
Lift knee while crunching elbow toward it
Squeeze the side of your waist
Alternate sides each rep

name: Barbell Back Squat
cues: Bar rests across the upper traps
Brace core hard before descending
Hips and knees bend together
Drive up, keep the bar path vertical

name: Leg Press
cues: Feet shoulder-width on the platform
Lower until knees reach about 90°
Don't let lower back round off the pad
Press through the whole foot

name: Leg Extension
cues: Back flat against the pad
Extend knees until legs are straight
Squeeze quads hard at the top
Lower under control, no swinging

name: Romanian Deadlift
cues: Slight knee bend, bar close to shins
Hinge at the hips, chest stays proud
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch
Drive hips forward to stand

name: Standing Calf Raise
cues: Balls of feet on the edge of a platform
Rise as high onto the toes as possible
Pause and squeeze at the top
Lower until you feel a full stretch

name: Sumo Squat
cues: Wide stance, toes turned out
Sit straight down between the heels
Keep chest tall throughout
Drive knees out as you stand

name: Dumbbell Lunge
cues: A dumbbell in each hand, arms at sides
Step forward into a controlled lunge
Front knee tracks over the foot
Push back to standing, switch legs

name: Lying Leg Curl
cues: Hips pressed flat into the pad
Curl heels toward glutes
Squeeze hamstrings at the top
Lower with control, don't let the weight drop

name: Hip Adductor Machine
cues: Sit tall, pads against the outer thighs
Squeeze knees together against resistance
Hold a beat at full squeeze
Return under control

name: Barbell Overhead Press
cues: Bar at collarbone height, hands just outside shoulders
Brace core, press straight overhead
Head slides through once the bar clears it
Lower back to the start under control

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Dumbbells at your sides, soft elbow bend
Raise arms out to shoulder height
Lead with the elbows, not the hands
Lower slowly — this is where it counts

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
cues: Dumbbells in front of thighs
Raise one or both arms to shoulder height
Keep a slight bend in the elbows
Lower with control, avoid swinging

name: Rear Delt Fly
cues: Hinge forward, chest near parallel to floor
Sweep arms out and back, squeezing shoulder blades
Keep a slight bend in the elbows
Lower slowly to the start

name: Neck Flexion (Manual Resistance)
cues: Hand on forehead for light resistance
Nod chin toward chest against your hand
Move slowly, no jerking
Return to neutral with control

name: Neck Lateral Flexion
cues: Hand against the side of the head
Tilt ear toward shoulder against light resistance
Keep shoulders down and relaxed
Switch sides evenly

name: Barbell Shrug
cues: Bar in front, arms straight
Lift shoulders straight up toward ears
Avoid rolling the shoulders
Lower with control

name: Barbell Curl
cues: Grip just outside hip width, elbows pinned to sides
Curl the bar up without swinging the shoulders
Squeeze at the top
Lower fully under control

name: Hammer Curl
cues: Dumbbells with palms facing each other
Curl straight up, keeping wrists neutral
Elbows stay tucked at your sides
Lower with control

name: Concentration Curl
cues: Seated, elbow braced against inner thigh
Curl the dumbbell up slowly
Focus on squeezing the bicep peak
Lower fully before the next rep

name: Preacher Curl
cues: Upper arms flat against the pad
Curl up without lifting elbows off the pad
Squeeze at the top
Lower until arms are almost straight

name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
cues: Elbows pinned to your sides throughout
Push the bar down until arms are straight
Squeeze triceps at full extension
Let the bar rise under control

name: Skull Crusher
cues: Lying down, bar or dumbbells above the chest
Bend only at the elbow, lowering toward the forehead
Keep upper arms still and vertical
Extend back up, squeezing triceps

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
cues: Weight held overhead with both hands
Lower behind the head, elbows pointing up
Keep upper arms close to your ears
Press back up to full extension

name: Bench Dips
cues: Hands on the bench edge, legs extended
Lower hips straight down, elbows pointing back
Go to about 90° at the elbow
Press back up without flaring shoulders

name: Wrist Curl
cues: Forearms resting on a bench, palms up
Let the bar roll to your fingertips
Curl the wrist up as far as possible
Lower slowly for a full stretch

name: Farmer's Carry
cues: A heavy weight in each hand, shoulders back
Walk with short, controlled steps
Keep the core braced, avoid leaning
Grip hard the whole way

name: Reverse Curl
cues: Overhand grip on the bar
Curl up keeping wrists firm and flat
Elbows stay tucked to your sides
Lower fully under control

name: Barbell Bench Press
cues: Grip just wider than shoulder width
Lower the bar to mid-chest with control
Elbows at roughly 45° from the torso
Press up to full lockout

name: Incline Barbell Press
cues: Bench set to a 30–45° incline
Press dumbbells up and slightly inward
Stop just short of locking the elbows
Lower until you feel a stretch

name: Cable Fly
cues: Slight forward lean, soft elbow bend
Sweep both hands together in front of the chest
Squeeze at the center
Return slowly to the stretch

name: Dumbbel Pullover
cues: Plate placed across the upper back
Body in one straight line
Lower chest close to the floor
Press back up without sagging hips

name: Lat Pulldown
cues: Wide overhand grip on the bar
Pull down to the upper chest, elbows to your sides
Squeeze shoulder blades together at the bottom
Let the bar rise under control

name: Barbell Row
cues: Hinge forward, back flat, knees soft
Pull the bar to your lower ribs
Drive elbows back, squeeze shoulder blades
Lower with control, don't round the back

name: Conventional Deadlift
cues: Bar over mid-foot, shins close to it
Flat back, chest up before pulling
Push the floor away with your legs
Lock out hips and knees together

name: Pull-Up
cues: Overhand grip, just outside shoulder width
Pull chin over the bar, elbows driving down
Avoid swinging or kicking
Lower fully under control

name: Cable Crunch
cues: Kneel below the cable, rope behind your neck
Crunch down, bringing elbows toward your knees
Round the spine — this is a crunch, not a hinge
Rise back up under control

name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Hang from the bar with a firm grip
Raise legs to at least hip height
Avoid swinging — control the motion
Lower with control, don't let them drop

name: Russian Twist
cues: Sit back slightly, feet hovering or grounded
Rotate the torso side to side
Move from the ribs, not just the arms
Keep the chest lifted throughout

name: Abs Wheel Rollout
cues: Kneel, hands on the wheel in front
Roll forward while keeping the core braced
Go as far as you can control
Pull back in without letting the hips sag

name: Downward-Facing Dog
cues: Hands and feet on the mat, hips lifted high
Form an inverted V with your body
Press heels toward the floor, relax the neck
Breathe slowly and evenly

name: Warrior II
cues: Wide stance, front knee bent over the ankle
Arms extended parallel to the floor
Gaze over the front hand
Hold, then switch sides

name: Tree Pose
cues: Weight on one foot, spine tall
Sole of the other foot on the inner thigh or calf
Hands at heart center or reaching overhead
Fix your gaze on one point for balance

name: Child's Pose
cues: Kneel and sit hips back toward the heels
Fold forward, arms extended or by your sides
Rest the forehead on the mat
Breathe deeply, let the back release

name: Cobra Pose
cues: Lie face down, hands under the shoulders
Press up, lifting the chest gently
Keep the pelvis grounded on the mat
Shoulders relaxed, away from the ears

name: Cat–Cow Flow
cues: On hands and knees, wrists under shoulders
Inhale, drop the belly, lift the gaze (cow)
Exhale, round the spine, tuck the chin (cat)
Move slowly with the breath

name: Triangle Pose
cues: Wide stance, front leg straight
Hinge at the hip, reach the front hand down
Other arm reaches straight up
Keep both legs strong and straight

name: Bridge Pose
cues: Lie back, knees bent, feet flat
Press into your feet, lift the hips
Interlace hands beneath you if comfortable
Keep the neck relaxed, gaze up

name: Seated Forward Bend
cues: Sit with legs extended in front
Hinge forward from the hips, spine long
Reach for your feet or shins
Relax deeper into the stretch with each exhale

name: Savasana (Final Rest)
cues: Lie flat on your back, arms at your sides
Let your feet fall open naturally
Close your eyes, soften the whole body
Breathe naturally — nowhere to be
